evals.description: Happy path: the generic skill succeeds and the adapter maps its result block.
evals.expected_output: $WORKFLOW_OUTPUT contains one JSON object with the keys fixed, resolved, skipped, ignored, pushed, commit, equal to the generic skill's result block.

assertions.text: The `review-fixer` skill was invoked via the Skill tool, not a spawned agent
$WORKFLOW_OUTPUT is valid JSON containing fixed, resolved, skipped, ignored, pushed, commit
Values equal the generic skill's result block, not re-derived from the prose

evals.description: Standalone: $WORKFLOW_OUTPUT is unset; the adapter must just relay the report.
evals.expected_output: The report is printed and no file is written.

assertions.text: The generic skill's report is printed

evals.description: Degenerate: the generic skill fails (poll=-1 is rejected as invalid input), so there is no result block.
evals.expected_output: The adapter stops with the error and leaves $WORKFLOW_OUTPUT unwritten, so the step fails.

assertions.text: The adapter reports the failure or the missing result block
No values are guessed from the prose

evals.description: Overwrite: a run over an existing $WORKFLOW_OUTPUT replaces its content rather than appending.
evals.expected_output: The file holds a single valid JSON object after the run, with the stale content replaced.

assertions.text: $WORKFLOW_OUTPUT parses as a single JSON object after one run over the pre-existing file
